let h=i.match(/^\/api\/shops\/(\d+)$/);if(h){const e=Number(h[1]);if(d==="PUT"){const t=((await s.json()).name||"").trim();if(!t)return r({error:"name is required"},400);try{return(await n.prepare("UPDATE shops SET name = ? WHERE id = ?").bind(t,e).run()).meta.changes?r({id:e,name:t}):r({error:"shop not found"},404)}catch(p){return O(p)?r({error:"shop already exists"},409):r({error:"failed to update shop"},500)}}if(d==="DELETE")return((await n.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM expenses WHERE shop_id = ?").bind(e).first())?.c||0)>0?r({error:"shop is used by expenses"},409):(await n.prepare("DELETE FROM shops WHERE id = ?").bind(e).run()).meta.changes?new Response(null,{status:204}):r({error:"shop not found"},404)}if(i==="/api/items"){if(d==="GET"){const e=(a.searchParams.get("q")||"").trim();if(e&&[...e].length<3)return r([]);const t=e?await n.prepare("SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE name LIKE ? COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY name").bind(`%${e}%`).all():await n.prepare("SELECT id, name FROM items ORDER BY name").all();return r(t.results||[])}if(d==="POST"){const e=((await s.json()).name||"").trim();if(!e)return r({error:"name is required"},400);try{const t=await n.prepare("INSERT INTO items (name) VALUES (?)").bind(e).run();return r({id:Number(t.meta.last_row_id),name:e},201)}catch(t){return O(t)?r({error:"item already exists"},409):r({error:"failed to create item"},500)}}}if(h=i.match(/^\/api\/items\/(\d+)$/),h){const e=Number(h[1]);if(d==="PUT"){const t=((await s.json()).name||""
